summary: This change adds stricter validation so that orders missing a customer ID or valid payment method will now be rejected with a ValidationError before submission.

items.title: Orders missing required fields are now rejected
items.before: Orders with missing customer ID or payment method were accepted.
items.after: Orders missing a customer ID or a valid payment method are now rejected with a ValidationError before submit is called.
items.statement: Enabling strict=True makes validate reject any order missing a customer ID or a valid payment method, raising a ValidationError before submit is ever called.

items.title: Order processing pipeline
items.statement: Order processing is a critical part of the checkout flow and involves many steps including validation, payment capture, inventory reservation, and notification delivery across several backend services.
